OLLAMA_BASE_URL.description: Ollama API base URL for local embedding (bge-m3 model)

EMBEDDING_PROVIDER.description: Embedding provider: 'ollama' (safe local default), 'gemini' (Google Vertex AI), 'openai' (official OpenAI embedding via compatible relay), 'auto' (Gemini + Ollama fallback), or 'openai-auto' (official OpenAI embedding via relay + Ollama fallback)

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key (required if EMBEDDING_PROVIDER is 'gemini' or 'auto')

GEMINI_PROJECT_ID.description: Google Cloud Project ID for Vertex AI (required if EMBEDDING_PROVIDER is 'gemini' or 'auto')

GEMINI_MODEL.description: Google Vertex AI embedding model name

OPENAI_EMBEDDING_API_KEY.description: API key for an OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint (required if EMBEDDING_PROVIDER is 'openai' or 'openai-auto')

OPENAI_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL.description: Base URL or full /embeddings endpoint for the relay that serves official OpenAI embedding models

OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL.description: Model name for the OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint

DEFAULT_PROJECT.description: Default project identifier for memory isolation
